VIBORA TITAN JUNIOR CLASSIC WHITE - We present the most Premium Vibora junior racket from the Spanish brand. For the little ones in the house. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The VIBORA TITAN JUNIOR CLASSIC WHITE is Vibora Padel's new bet for the 2025 season. A smaller, lighter weight JR version for children who want their first racket and also with a beautiful aesthetic.

PLAYER TYPE

The Titan Junior is a racket that will suit any child, of any level, very well. Vibora takes great care of weight and balance, facilitating correct learning for children.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

We analyze this VIBORA TITAN JUNIOR CLASSIC WHITE model in more detail:

- It has a reinforced carbon fiber frame to provide greater resistance to breakage.

- The planes are made of fiberglass.

- Multidensity Eva Rubber interior. It is one of the best rubber in Vibora 2025 blades.

- Its weight is 330-345 grams.

PLAY STYLE

On the track it is a very light track. Being a junior padel racket, it will offer us light weight and good handling.

products.title: Softee Rotatory Negro Rojo - Softee
products.description:
SOFTEE ROTATORY BLACK RED - Access range padel shoes for all types of players. Great quality of finishes and very comfortable for the first games and training sessions. The SOFTEE ROTATORY BLACK RED are Softee padel shoes that will leave us with a very good feeling on the court. When you choose padel shoes, the composition of the material is essential to ensure not only performance but also durability and comfort.

This model has been manufactured with the following components:

- PU polyurethane: super wear-resistant material, thus extending the useful life of the shoes and being able to offer an intense game.

- Rubber and TPR: Rubber and TPR are ideal for soles because they provide excellent grip on the court surface. This is vital for making quick turns and changes of direction without slipping. The sole is clay type.

products.title: Mochila White Sport 2026 - Star Vie
products.description:
MOCHILA WHITE SPORT 2026 - Elegante mochila Starvie para temporada 2026. Con compartimento para palas, zapatillas, ropa y objetos personales. La MOCHILA WHITE SPORT 2026 es para nuestro gusto la más bonita de la nueva colección. El diseño en blanco con detalles en dorado y negro le queda muy bien. Este modelo cuenta con dos asas muy bien acolchadas, además de un enganche para un mejor ajuste.

Tendremos tres compartimentos principales, que son el destinado a las palas de pádel; el destinado a nuestro material como ropa, toallas, etc; y el destinado a las zapatillas de pádel o ropa sucia. Lo tendremos todo bien organizado.

products.englishDescription:
WHITE SPORT 2026 BACKPACK - Elegant Starvie backpack for the 2026 season. With compartment for rackets, shoes, clothing and personal items. The WHITE SPORT 2026 BACKPACK is, in our opinion, the most beautiful of the new collection. The white design with gold and black details looks great on it. We will have three main compartments, which are the one for the paddle tennis rackets; the one intended for our material such as clothes, towels, etc.; and the one intended for paddle tennis shoes or dirty clothes. We will have everything well organized.
